name: agent-flow-ui
description: 研发智能体工作流编排服务 — 前端 + 同源 BFF（无构建；运行时依赖默认零，例外走准入）

scripts.check:syntax: for f in server.js bff/*.js assets/js/ui.js assets/js/mock-data.js assets/js/api.js assets/js/shared/*.js assets/js/workflow/*.js assets/js/workflow/views/*.js assets/js/pages/*.js tools/*.js tools/*.mjs tests/bff/*.js tests/workflow/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:docs && npm run docs:index:check && npm run check:deps && npm run check:architecture && npm run check:scenario-trace && npm run test:bff && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:scenarios && npm run test:workflow
scripts.test:gate: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:docs && npm run docs:index:check && npm run check:deps && npm run check:architecture && npm run check:scenario-trace && npm run test:bff
scripts.test:workflow: node --test tests/workflow && node tools/verify-workflow-list.js && node tools/verify-workflow-editor.js
